info.title: Thesis Monitor Public Action API
info.description: Collect thesis evidence, register versioned investment theses, manage the monitored stock list, read daily thesis assessments, and retrieve macro briefings, regimes, events, and ticker-level macro impacts. Administrative jobs are excluded.

post.summary: Start or update thesis monitoring for a stock
post.description: Use when the user says a stock should be monitored going forward. First collect current company evidence and construct a concrete thesis. Changed thesis fields create a new version; an identical request is idempotent.

get.summary: List monitored stocks and their current theses

post.summary: Stop monitoring a stock without deleting its history

ticker.title: Ticker
ticker.description: Ticker, stock code, or supported Korean company name.

exchange.title: Exchange
exchange.description: Exchange such as KRX or NASDAQ.

strengthen_signals.title: Strengthen Signals
strengthen_signals.description: Concrete future facts that would strengthen the thesis.

weaken_signals.title: Weaken Signals
weaken_signals.description: Concrete future facts that would weaken the thesis.

invalidation_signals.title: Invalidation Signals
invalidation_signals.description: Explicit facts that would invalidate the thesis.

macro_exposures.title: Macro Exposures
macro_exposures.description: Conditional macro factors and transmission channels for this thesis.
